tool-call.eventDescription: Any MCP tool call (check_email, verify_bulk, check_mx, is_disposable). DNS-only checks by default; SMTP handshake is opt-in. Zero upstream API cost.

_note: Discovery requests (initialize, tools/list) are deliberately NOT registered as charge events, so agents can connect and enumerate tools for free. Set pricing via the Apify API (PUT /v2/acts/{id}); apify push does not write pricing.
